# scamp_storage_box (Resource)

Manages a Storage Box: one file tree on its own server, served over S3, SFTP, FTPS and WebDAV. Its S3 side works as a Terraform state backend, with the lock file (use_lockfile).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_storage_box" "tfstate" {
  name       = "tfstate"
  package    = "st-50"
  grow_up_to = "st-100"
  protocols  = ["s3"]
}

output "tfstate_endpoint" {
  value = scamp_storage_box.tfstate.s3_endpoint
}

output "tfstate_access_key" {
  value = scamp_storage_box.tfstate.access_key
}

output "tfstate_secret_key" {
  value     = scamp_storage_box.tfstate.secret_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Terraform state in a Storage Box

A backend cannot use a resource of the same configuration, so the box is made once by its own small
configuration (with local state), and every other configuration keeps its state in it:

```terraform
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "storage"
    key    = "office/terraform.tfstate"
    region = "us-east-1"

    endpoints = {
      s3 = "https://tfstate-xxxxxx.storage.serverscamp.com" # s3_endpoint of the box
    }
    use_path_style              = true
    use_lockfile                = true # lock file in the box, Terraform 1.10 and later
    skip_credentials_validation = true
    skip_region_validation      = true
    skip_requesting_account_id  = true
    skip_metadata_api_check     = true
  }
}
```

The keys come from the environment, so they are not in the code:

```shell
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(terraform -chdir=bootstrap output -raw tfstate_access_key)
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(terraform -chdir=bootstrap output -raw tfstate_secret_key)
terraform init
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the box: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Changing it replaces the box and every file in it.
- `package` (String) Package by slug or name: st-50 (50 GB) up to st-10000 (10 TB). The box moves up by itself only to grow_up_to; a package is never moved down, so changing it replaces the box.

### Optional

- `grow_up_to` (String) A bigger package the box moves up to by itself when it is full. Changed in place.
- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network, attached to a router. Without it the account's default network. Changing it replaces the box and every file in it.
- `protocols` (Set of String) Protocols the box serves: s3, sftp, ftp, webdav. All of them by default. Changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String) S3 access key of the main user.
- `bucket` (String) The box's one S3 bucket: storage.
- `host` (String) The box's name in DNS, NAME-xxxxxx.storage.serverscamp.com.
- `id` (String) The box's id.
- `ip` (String) Public address of the box.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the main user for SFTP, FTPS and WebDAV.
- `private_ip` (String) Address of the box in its network.
- `region` (String) S3 region to sign with: us-east-1.
- `s3_endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint, https://HOST. Use path-style addressing.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret key of the main user.
- `state` (String) creating, configuring, active or failed.
- `user` (String) The box's main user, with access to everything.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_storage_box.tfstate 3f2a1b00-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
